# Code of conduct

We want collaboration here to be useful, direct, and respectful.

Participants are expected to:

- discuss ideas and code without personal attacks or harassment
- assume good intent while remaining specific about technical concerns
- welcome contributors with different backgrounds and experience levels
- protect private information and avoid publishing credentials or sensitive logs
- accept maintainer decisions about scope, safety, and release quality

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, deliberate disruption, doxxing, and sexualized conduct.

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository maintainers. Maintainers may edit or remove content, close contributions, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation when needed to protect the community.
